description: This file defines an internal interface 'ISiloMetadataClient' for accessing silo metadata within the Orleans runtime membership service, specifically providing a method to retrieve silo metadata asynchronously based on a silo address.

classes.name: ISiloMetadataClient
classes.description: An internal interface that declares a method for asynchronously retrieving silo metadata given a silo address.

methods.name: GetSiloMetadata
methods.description: An asynchronous method that returns a Task wrapping the SiloMetadata for a specified SiloAddress.
